data_origin: Manual transcription of pinned HTML/config/source reports; not complete review.json.

trials.value_origin: Harness reconstruction of 62.5% vs 37.5% with 16 women per arm; no independent complete trial table acquired.
trials.passage: Ben Ayed 2009, abstract: '32 PCOS women were recruited in the study and equally allocated to the two groups. The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 62.5% compared with 37.5% in the placebo group.' Equal allocation of 32 -> 16 per arm; counts are exact: 62.5% of 16 = 10, 37.5% of 16 = 6 (an S2 add-on-to-clomifene contrast, metformin+CC vs CC+placebo).

trials.value_origin: Harness percentage reconstruction; original full article Table 2 independently prints these participant counts.
trials.passage: Moll 2006 (BMJ, NCT-registered multicentre RCT), abstract: '111 women were allocated to clomifene citrate plus metformin (metformin group) and 114 women were allocated to clomifene citrate plus placebo (placebo group). The ovulation rate in the metformin group was 64% compared with 72% in the placebo group.' Counts recovered as the unique integers consistent with the reported rate and denominator: round(0.64*111)=71 (71/111=63.96% -> '64%'; 70->63%, 72->65%), round(0.72*114)=82 (82/114=71.9% -> '72%'; 81->71%, 83->73%). Metformin ARM WORSE than placebo (an S2 add-on-to-clomifene contrast; treatment-naive PCOS).

trials.value_origin: Original abstract explicitly prints participants who ovulated, separate from conception counts.
trials.passage: abstract arm-level counts (percentage-corroborated): RESULT(S): In the metformin and placebo groups, 9 of 12 participants (75%) and 4 of 15 participants (27%) ovulated, and 6 of 11 participants (55%) and 1 of 14 participants (7%) conceived, respectively

moll_safety.limitation: Full original HTML independently read; pinned ft_16769748.txt contains abstract, metadata and end notes but no article body or numerical tables. Source licence/admission must be adjudicated.
moll_safety.source_location: Original Results narrative after Tables 2 and 3; the efficacy counts are in Table 2, NOT the discontinuation counts.

retraction.action: Keep out of synthesis; comparator wording defect does not authorize reinstatement.
retraction.evidence: Original journal retraction notice indexed in PubMed, independently checked during this audit.

lexical_fixtures.legro_source_informed: Women were randomized to clomiphene plus placebo, metformin plus placebo, or the combination of metformin and clomiphene.
lexical_fixtures.kazerooni_source_informed_retracted: Metformin or placebo preceded clomiphene, which both treatment arms received in the second cycle.
lexical_fixtures.placebo_group_control: Women received metformin or were assigned to a placebo group.
lexical_fixtures.placebo_controlled_control: A placebo-controlled trial compared metformin added to clomiphene with placebo added to clomiphene.
lexical_fixtures.no_placebo_control: A randomized study compared metformin with letrozole.
lexical_fixtures.negation_control: This was not a placebo-controlled trial.

fixture_scope: Source-informed short paraphrases, NOT full publication records; lexical branch only, no end-to-end screener; integrity and outcome gates not exercised.

legro_diagnostic.endpoint: At least one documented ovulation during follow-up
legro_diagnostic.origin: Auditor complements of source-reported no-documented-ovulation counts; NOT cycle-level rates and NOT a source-printed OR.
legro_diagnostic.limitations: Eligibility correction does not by itself authorize pooling. Adjudicate outcome definition, non-observation/missingness, treatment duration and history, extended-release preparation, admissible source licensing and source binding. Do not convert repeated cycles to independent participants.
